column1: # Kody Runtime compatibility: which cell release fits which product release.
# The hub and the runtime-worker are built from the product's own tree and
# release with it, so a product release names its hub's protocol version. A
# cell and a hub negotiate on every connection (kodus-ai libs/runtime/protocol):
# both decode their current version and the one before it, and the hub refuses
# a hello that does not list its version. The rule this table encodes: a cell
# release fits a product release when the cell's protocols include the hub's.
# A shared protocol version is necessary, not sufficient: a hub decodes hello
# strictly, and a hub older than kodus-ai 0e6f8490c refuses the hello
# `capabilities` field a newer cell sends (kodus-ai docs/runtime/deploy-2026-11-12.md,
# "Hub before cells"), and a hub older than kodus-ai 07f2e368e refuses a
# hello with more than 32 features; the cell's list is at 32 (kodus-ai
# apps/runtime-cell/internal/protocol constants_gen.go CellFeatures), so the
# next feature needs that hub first.
# Since kodus-ai 7b70cf2dc a hub of protocol H accepts a cell whose highest
# version C is H-1 <= C <= H (cell_too_new / cell_too_old otherwise), and
# since 754d88225 a release carries PROTOCOL ("<lowest> <highest>", signed in
# SHA256SUMS) and `cell update` refuses one above what the hub last
# acknowledged (hello feature cellProtocols, answered by the hub's ack).
# So each row names a cell release proven with that hub,
# and an upgrade moves the hub first, then the cells (scripts/runtime/upgrade.sh).
# scripts/runtime/lib.sh reads it (tab-separated, '#' comments). The release
# workflows of kodus-ai append a row per release; the digests of each row are
# in images.lock. Columns:
#   product        product release (IMAGE_TAG), or `unreleased` for local builds
#   hub_protocol   the protocol version the hub of that release speaks
#   cell_release   a cell release tag that fits it (runtime-cell/vX.Y.Z)
#   cell_protocols the versions that cell decodes, comma-separated
#   backends       isolation backends that cell can run (gvisor, firecracker)
#   source         where the row was read
# No product release carries the Runtime yet and no cell release has run
# (kodus-ai docs/runtime/cell-distribution.md), so the only row is the
# development tree: protocol 1 (libs/runtime/protocol/envelope.ts
# PROTOCOL_VERSION, apps/runtime-cell/internal/protocol/types_gen.go
# ProtocolVersion), backend gvisor (firecracker is refused until phase P2).
#product
unreleased
